description:
About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, United States

Overview

GitHub is looking for a director to help lead GitHub’s Technical Program Management team in our Engineering organization. You should be an ambitious, passionate, technical, and collaborative leader with a strong background in empowering high performing teams and an ability to deliver results through technical programs. 


The Director, TPM will strengthen TPM's role as a trusted integrator, driving clarity, accountability, and execution across complex, cross-functional initiatives. They will help teams frame problems, align stakeholders, and accelerate decision-making while raising the effectiveness of TPMs and scaling their influence across the company. This director will foster a culture of ownership, bias for action, and operational excellence, ensuring execution remains tightly aligned with strategic priorities. 


Responsibilities

Opportunity and Solutions Identification 

  • Demonstrates and builds experiences across multiple groups or divisions. Leads and coaches teams to develop problem statements and form hypotheses for products and services across divisional boundaries to address highly complex business, program, customer needs, and/or market opportunities; identifies dependencies of other features. 

  • Determines and leads process improvements to quickly scope insights, and drives change management initiatives. Uses industry understanding to direct teams to ensure alignment between the customer, the market, internal stakeholders, senior leadership, and the goals and strategy of GitHub. 

  • Holds teams accountable for collaborating with others (e.g., Engineering, Marketing, Design) to ensure that they can satisfy customer requirements. Provides expertise to help teams validate the market size and opportunity of greatest value for the company. Facilitates collaboration between their team and other partner teams to bring about solutions. 

 

Program Planning and Success 

  • Provides expertise to help teams define the multiple program goals and prioritization for the products and services they own. Guides teams to translate the needs of the organization and other teams into program goals and prioritize deliverables based on data insights.  

  • Guides teams to engage in active risk management (proactive and reactive) to identify risks and propose mitigations for risks using data (e.g., telemetry, usage, net satisfaction, customer satisfaction). 

  • Coaches teams to define success criteria and performance metrics (e.g., Objectives and Key Results [OKRs], Key Performance Indicators [KPIs] such as quality and performance) of products, services and works with engineering to ensure needed telemetry is developed. Provides expert knowledge to help teams deeply understand the return on investment. 

  

Program/Service Development 

  • Acts as a subject matter expert in orchestrating and integrating efforts for the development and implementation process of product, services on large cross functional projects with internal teams and external partners. Drives teams to collaborate and coordinate across teams and perspectives to ensure alignment on product management and release, including tradeoffs, adjustments, and improvements as feasible. 

  • Guides teams to partner with the engineering team to contribute, prioritize, and deliver on the roadmap for product, service. Drives teams to understand the value proposition for the feature(s)/feature areas and answer technical questions on the feature(s)/feature areas they own.  

  • Guides teams to justify capacity requirements and advocate for the right resource allocation. Partners with the Engineering team to know the feature capabilities in alignment with the goal updates and associated tradeoffs. 

  • Guides teams tracking, coordinating, and communicating end-to-end project schedules for products, services. Ensures teams establish and monitor processes, and hold other stakeholders accountable for following the established schedule and processes. 

  • Guides teams when tracking and managing dependencies to enable cohesive, connected user scenarios, and to avoid issues and mitigate risks. Coaches teams to make adjustments or course corrections when projects are not aligned to schedules or goals. 

  • Drives teams to develop the staging and implementation plan for piloting/release in alignment with Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for products, services, its development timeline, and the introduction to the different programs. Ensures teams collaborate with stakeholders to monitor progress and adjust as needed. 

  • Helps teams lead governance programs and processes to ensure that specific performance requirements and standards are met throughout the development lifecycle (e.g., quality, compliance, privacy, security, safety, accessibility). 

 

Continuous Improvement 

  • Provides expertise to help teams partner with others to collect performance metrics (e.g., Key Performance Indicators [KPIs] such as usage, quality, speed, and cost), monitor and report on progress (e.g., business reviews), and derive insights that lead to productive courses of action. 

  • Ensures teams share insights with Engineering and other partners. Leads teams to form hypotheses to technical needs, perform experiments, and iterate to drive improvement in specific performance metrics that have measurable impact. 


Qualifications

Required Qualifications 

  • 8+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 6+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 4+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years experience in managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • 10+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 10+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 8+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR Doctorate in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 6+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years people management experience.
  • 4+ years experience designing, building, or supporting software systems. 

Compensation Range

The base salary range for this job is USD $140,400.00 - USD $372,300.00 /Yr.

These pay ranges are intended to cover roles based across the United States. An individual's base pay depends on various factors including geographical location and review of experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant. At GitHub certain roles are eligible for benefits and additional rewards, including annual bonus and stock. These rewards are allocated based on individual impact in role. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee's role.

This position will be open for a minimum of 3 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

GitHub values

  • Customer-obsessed
  • Ship to learn
  • Growth mindset
  • Own the outcome
  • Better together
  • Diverse and inclusive

Manager fundamentals

  • Model
  • Coach
  • Care

Leadership principles

  • Create clarity
  • Generate energy
  • Deliver success

Who We Are

GitHub is the world’s leading AI-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub.
Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.
Join us, and let’s change the world, together.

EEO Statement

GitHub is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. We don't discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other differences. Also, if you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About This Role

Crusoe is scaling one of the fastest-growing global workplace and data center portfolios in the industry, with active real estate initiatives spanning San Francisco, Denver, London, Tel Aviv, Bellevue, and beyond, alongside a rapidly expanding global data center footprint. We're looking for a Senior Director, Real Estate & Portfolio Strategy to lead the strategy, execution, and financial management of our global co-location, manufacturing office and data center lease portfolio.

Reporting directly to the VP, DIG Operations, this role will be a critical partner in aligning our real estate strategy with business growth, headcount planning, employee experience, and long-term financial objectives across both corporate office, co-location, manufacturing and data center real estate. You'll work closely with our exclusive global brokerage partner, Legal, Finance, People, Data Center Operations, and business leaders to deliver thoughtful, data-driven real estate solutions that support Crusoe's continued expansion.

This is an exciting opportunity for a senior real estate leader who thrives on managing multiple concurrent transactions across office, manufacturing and data center/colocation portfolios, enjoys the financial and analytical side of commercial real estate, and wants to build scalable portfolio strategies, lease governance, and audit processes for a rapidly growing global company.

 

What You'll Be Working On

 

• Portfolio Strategy and Asset Management: by partnering with Finance, People, Workplace, and Data Center Operations leadership to translate hiring forecasts, capacity plans, and space/power utilization into real estate recommendations. Evaluate expansion, consolidation, renewal, and exit opportunities across global office and data center markets.

• Lease Portfolio Management: own the master lease abstract database across all locations, tracking key dates, terms, options, renewal windows, and obligations to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.

• Lease Review & Abstracting: lead comprehensive lease review and abstracting for new and existing leases, including manufacturing office, data center, and cloud colocation agreements — abstracting key business, financial, and legal terms into standardized formats for portfolio-wide tracking and reporting.

• Transaction Execution: manage end-to-end real estate transactions — including new office and manufacturing leases, renewals, subleases, expansions, contractions, and terminations — in close partnership with our brokers and legal counsel.

• Cloud Colocation & Data Center Lease Management: lead ongoing lease management for cloud colocation and data center leases, including power/capacity commitments, service level agreements, interconnection terms, expansion rights, and hyperscaler lease administration.

• Critical Date Management: own the tracking and management of all critical lease dates across the portfolio — including notice periods, renewal and termination options, rent escalations, expansion/contraction windows, and compliance deadlines — ensuring proactive action ahead of key milestones.

• Financial Analysis & Reporting: build and maintain cash flow models, occupancy cost analyses, rent schedules, lease comparisons, escalations, and CAM reconciliations to support executive decision-making across office, manufacturing and data center portfolios.

• Executive Reporting: prepare business cases, portfolio updates, and executive presentations that translate complex lease and financial data into clear, actionable recommendations for executive leadership.

• Stakeholder Coordination: serve as the primary point of contact between Workplace, Finance, Legal, Procurement, Data Center Operations, and site leadership on all lease-related matters, including purchase order and approval workflows in Coupa.

• Broker & Transaction Management: serve as the relationship manager for Crusoe's global brokerage partner, leading lease negotiations, coordinating transaction strategy, and driving favorable business and financial outcomes across the portfolio.

• Compliance, Risk & Audit Management: track insurance requirements, certificates of occupancy, permits, and critical lease obligations across office and data center locations; manage lease and portfolio audits, proactively identifying and mitigating portfolio risks.

• Site Selection: partner with brokers and internal stakeholders on new market evaluations, including market analysis, site tours, financial comparisons, and lease execution for both office and manufacturing sites.

• Portfolio Systems & Process Improvement: lead the evaluation and implementation of a global lease administration platform while continuously improving portfolio reporting, documentation, and governance — including audit readiness — to support Crusoe's continued growth.

 

What You'll Bring to the Team

• Bachelor's degree in Real Estate, Business, Finance, or a related field.

• 15+ years of experience in corporate real estate, portfolio strategy, lease administration, or commercial real estate transaction management, including experience with data center or cloud colocation leasing.

• Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent lease transactions across multiple geographies and asset types, including office and data center/colocation.

• Strong financial acumen, including developing business cases, cash flow projections, occupancy cost analyses, lease economics, and executive recommendations.

• Hands-on experience with lease review, abstracting, and management, including tracking of critical dates, options, and obligations across a large, complex portfolio.

• Experience negotiating commercial lease terms in partnership with brokers and legal counsel, including colocation and data center-specific terms (power, SLAs, interconnection, expansion rights).

• Experience leading or supporting lease and portfolio audits, with a strong understanding of compliance and risk management practices.

• Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience influencing cross-functional partners and executive leadership without direct authority.

• Experience implementing or administering lease management software is highly desirable.

• Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets with strong financial modeling and analytical skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex real estate and financial information for executive audiences.

• Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with evolving business priorities.

 

Bonus Points

• Experience working directly with a global brokerage firm (e.g., JLL, CBRE, Cushman & Wakefield).

• Experience supporting international real estate transactions and global portfolios.

title: Director, Product Portfolio & Product Lifecycle IT Transformation Lead
description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is a global leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. We design, build and service cutting-edge equipment that helps our customers manufacture display and semiconductor chips – the brains of devices we use every day. As the foundation of the global electronics industry, Applied enables the exciting technologies that literally connect our world – like AI and IoT. If you want to push the boundaries of materials science and engineering to create next generation technology, join us to deliver material innovation that changes the world. 

What We Offer

Salary:
$176,500.00 - $242,500.00

Location:
Santa Clara,CA

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits. 

About the Role

The Director, Product Portfolio & Product Lifecycle Transformation leads business and IT transformation initiatives that enable product lifecycle management, program governance, and portfolio value realization across a complex global enterprise environment. This role partners closely with business stakeholders, IT teams, and cross-functional organizations to drive integrated platform execution, business process improvement, and operational excellence across the end-to-end Idea-to-Retire lifecycle. The Director translates business priorities into scalable process and technology solutions that improve governance, visibility, and portfolio performance.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead transformation initiatives across product lifecycle, project and portfolio management, and related business process and IT platform capabilities

- Partner with business and IT stakeholders to define priorities, roadmaps, and execution plans aligned with organizational objectives

- Drive end-to-end execution of complex IT-enabled programs, including scope, milestones, dependencies, governance, risk management, and value realization

- Enable and improve end-to-end Idea-to-Retire business processes through integrated platforms, process standardization, and cross-functional alignment

- Provide leadership in product lifecycle, program governance, and portfolio management to strengthen planning, transparency, decision-making, and execution

- Lead implementation, integration, and optimization efforts involving Siemens PLM, SAP S/4, and related enterprise platforms

- Translate business requirements into scalable digital solutions that support product development, project resource management, and portfolio planning processes

- Establish governance mechanisms, execution cadences, and stakeholder engagement approaches that support delivery, adoption, and sustained business value

- Drive adoption of industry best practices and process harmonization across product and project portfolio management capabilities

- Lead cross-functional teams, program partners, and stakeholders through change management, issue resolution, and execution delivery

- Define, monitor, and report success measures, portfolio health indicators, and business value realization metrics for strategic programs.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field

- Significant experience in enterprise IT, digital transformation, product lifecycle management, ERP, or portfolio management environments

- Proven experience leading large-scale business process and IT transformation programs

- Strong stakeholder management experience across both business and IT organizations

- Experience with Siemens PLM, SAP S/4, or comparable enterprise platforms supporting product lifecycle and portfolio processes

- Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives with senior stakeholder visibility, multiple dependencies, and enterprise impact

- Strong communication, influencing, and change leadership skills

Preferred Qualifications

- Advanced degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field

- Experience in semiconductor, manufacturing, or other complex product-based global organizations

- Experience leading platform-enabled transformation across Idea-to-Retire processes

- Strong understanding of industry best practices in product and project portfolio management

- Experience building governance models and operating mechanisms that improve execution and business value realization

- Demonstrated success aligning technology solutions with business priorities and portfolio objectives

Functional Knowledge

- Product lifecycle, program governance, project and portfolio value realization through integrated IT platforms

- Product and project portfolio management business processes and platform enablement

- Product development and project resource management processes within complex enterprise environments

- Business process transformation and program execution leadership in IT implementation environments

- End-to-end Idea-to-Retire transformation enabled through integrated digital platforms

- Enterprise platforms such as Siemens PLM and SAP S/4

Additional Information

Time Type:
Full time

Employee Type:
Assignee / Regular

Travel:
Yes, 10% of the Time

Relocation Eligible:
No

In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation such as participation in a bonus and a stock award program, as applicable.

For all sales roles, the posted salary range is the Target Total Cash (TTC) range for the role, which is the sum of base salary and target bonus amount at 100% goal achievement.

title: Staff Security Engineer - Blue Team (UK)
description:
Olo is a leading SaaS platform accelerating digital transformation in the restaurant industry, by helping customers deliver more personalised and profitable guest experiences. As a result, our digital ordering, payment, and guest engagement solutions enable brands to do more with less and make every guest feel like a regular.
 
Reporting to the Security Engineering Director, the Staff Security Engineer will act as technical lead of the Olo Security Blue Team and work on security defences that allow our systems to keep running while protecting the data of our clients and their customers.
 
Additionally, you will help in the identification and prioritisation of future project initiatives based on risk and execute cross-functional projects with a high degree of ownership and excellence, all while actively mentoring other team members and elevating the collective team’s capabilities and skill sets. If you are passionate about reducing risk while supporting innovation, we encourage you to apply!
 
You can work remotely from anywhere in Northern Ireland.

How you’ll make an impact
  • Guide and coach Olo’s Blue Team on Information Protection, Incident Detection and Response and Service Delivery.
  • You will provide strategic and technical oversight to the team and the program.
  • Technically lead a team of security engineers and analysts who hunt, detect, and respond to internal and external threats.
  • Collaborate with customers and partners to strengthen their security posture.
  • Drive ongoing optimisations by implementing new technologies, replacing technologies, addressing evolving threats, scaling practices and automating security activities.
  • Ultimately you will keep team member and customers data safe by identifying and mitigating vulnerabilities and risks by providing actionable guidance to product teams.

    • Information Protection
  • Lead Olo’s Information Protection program including the selection, testing, implementation and maintenance of security tools and services, security awareness, service provider management and the ongoing testing of those controls.
  • Oversee Vulnerability Management program including vulnerability assessments, risk scoring and vulnerability resolution.
  • Oversee Threat Hunting program to detect and mitigate advanced threats.
  • Manage non-event driven security reviews, including concept reviews, design reviews, patching, firewall rules and system configuration checks.
  • Apply Web application and API security principles and techniques, such as zero trust, RBAC, authentication, authorization, auditing, rate limiting, challenges, etc., to protect our cloud-based services from unauthorized access and abuse.

    • Incident Detection and Response
  • Oversee Incident Detection and Response program including ownership of incident response processes, tools and services and the ongoing continuous improvement of those controls.
  • Coordinate the detection and response to attacks through all incident phases.
  • Ensure incident reports are accurate, detailed and relevant.
  • Monitor, detect, and remediate misconfigurations and security risks across our cloud environments. 
  • Participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation.

    • Security Services
  • Oversee Security Services program including security support requests, risk assessments, vendor assessments, PCI and SOC audit support and service provider management.

    • What We'll Expect from You
  • 5+ years of Security Engineering, Security Operations or Security Architecture experience.
  • CISSP, GCIH or similar certification preferred.
  • Experience acting as technical lead to distributed teams consisting largely of remote engineers.
  • Experience complying with PCI-DSS and other compliance and regulatory standards.
  • Experience with attacker tactics, techniques and procedures.
  • Knowledge of information technology, evolving threats, attack patterns, incident response and cyber security standards.
  • Experience developing and leading incident response, remediation and mitigation activities, and providing status updates and reports.
  • Experience analyzing security events to discern events that qualify as a legitimate security incident as opposed to non-incidents (ie. incident investigation, implementing countermeasures, and conducting incident response).
  • Deep understanding of operating system, networking and application concepts.
  • Experience hardening Windows, MacOS, Linux Containers and Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with AWS security best practices and Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • Experience deploying and maintaining security technologies. (e.g. Access Proxies, API Gateway, Anti-Malware, Application Control, Cloud Security Posture, Data Leak Prevention, Data Mapping, Endpoint Detection & Response, Intrusion Detection System, File Integrity Monitoring, Firewalls, Mobile Device Management, Multi Factor Authentication, SIEM, Static Inspection, Vulnerability Assessment, Web Proxies, WAF and Zero Trust).
  • Adept at working with internal Product & Engineering, Legal, People & Culture, Finance and GTM teams and external partners, auditors and customers.
  • Ability to work during critical incidents or to support coverage requirements.

    • About Olo

    Olo is a leading restaurant technology provider with ordering, payment, and guest engagement solutions that help brands increase orders, streamline operations, and improve the guest experience. Each day, Olo processes millions of orders on its open SaaS platform, gathering the right data from each touchpoint into a single source—so restaurants can better understand and better serve every guest on every channel, every time. Over 800 restaurant brands trust Olo and its network of more than 400 integration partners to innovate on behalf of the restaurant community, accelerating technology’s positive impact and creating a world where every restaurant guest feels like a regular. Learn more at olo.com.

title: Principal Technical Program Manager - Technical Strategy Development
location: Mountain View, California, United States | San Diego, California, United States
description:
The Tech Strategic Programs organization delivers for Intuit and Tech Strategy by transforming and driving how our 10,000-person Technology ecosystem operates to accelerate outcomes for our customers.  This high performing team works with senior leaders and partners across the company.  We focus on strategic planning, the operating rhythm, executive narratives, workforce programs, and developing portfolio insights to accelerate the delivery of the highest priority areas for growth and customer impact leveraging emerging technology.

 

We are looking for creative problem solvers with a bias for action, an ability to analyze and connect the dots between multitudinous  sources of data and information, and a strong desire to drive tangible business impact. As a Principal Technical Program Manager, you will work alongside executive leaders to construct and deliver board and C-level content. You will also have an opportunity to work across the broader Product, Marketing, Finance, and Business segment communities to help innovate and drive change in how we operate. This position requires strong strategic problem solving and communication skills, the ability to inﬂuence and develop productive partnerships at all levels of the organization, solid business and technical acumen and a strong understanding of Intuit’s mission and values.


Responsibilities


  • Orchestrate development of executive-level presentations and content to be used by the CTO  in board meetings, CEO Staff meetings, and other forums

  • Partner with senior leaders and cross-functional teams (e.g. Product, Marketing, Finance, Business segments) to outline data-driven strategic frameworks decisions, and actionable recommendations

  • Lead strategy projects / work streams and new initiatives end-to-end, with limited guidance, from initial hypotheses to recommendation to operationalization

  • Develop narratives that highlight the outcomes delivered across the Tech Ecosystem and their connection to strategy

  • Build and maintain strong relationships across the Tech Ecosystem and CTO staff to ensure that we are thinking holistically across multiple tech priorities and in line with our technology strategy.

  • Design and implement frameworks and operating models that accelerate decision making, sharing of best practices, and operational excellence at scale across tech.  


Qualifications


  • 7-10 years of relevant experience in delivering signiﬁcant strategic and operational impact across an organization

  • Strategy and operations experience at a high growth startup, management consulting experience or strategic/analytical roles at large companies is desired

  • Proven track record in leveraging data, developing insight-backed hypotheses and driving learning plans to build compelling business cases

  • Demonstrated business and technical acumen, preferably in a SaaS or platform technology company.

  • Ownership mindset with an ability to convert strategic plans into actions, drive projects to completion, and sweat the details to deliver the outcome

  • Experienced change management leader who is able to inﬂuence and build trust across a highly cross-functional organization (peers, executives and working teams) to accelerate outcomes

  • Excellent communicator with strong presentation skills and compelling storytelling abilities; feel very comfortable leading and facilitating workshops and monthly/quarterly business reviews with executives and teams

  • Highly self-motivated, thrives in ambiguity and able to manage multiple projects with little day to day direction

  • Well-rounded interpersonal skills with the capacity to build relationships with senior stakeholders and collaborate across with team members across varying levels

  • Ability to generate innovative insights, ideas, and opportunities that drive tangible business outcomes

  • FinTech and/or SaaS experience a plus, but not required


Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position will be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

The expected base pay range for this position is:
Mountain View $238,000 - $322,000
San Diego, CA $219,500- $297,000

Proven ability to collaborate effectively across departments, influence stakeholders, and communicate complex ideas clearly.

Experience developing structured processes, measuring service effectiveness, and driving continuous improvement.

A customer-focused mindset, with the ability to understand customer needs and translate them into scalable service solutions.

title: Head of Project Management (m/w/d)
description:
Über Rotzinger Transver

Rotzinger Transver mit Standorten in Kaiseraugst und Altendorf in der Schweiz ist ein führender Anbieter von Lösungen für Produktflusssteuerung, Pufferung, Verteilung und Fördertechnik für die Lebensmittel-, Süsswaren- und Verpackungsindustrie.

Unser Portfolio umfasst eine breite Palette innovativer Systeme, die eine zuverlässige Produkthandhabung, eine stabile Linienleistung sowie eine effiziente Verbindung zwischen Verarbeitungs- und Verpackungsprozessen gewährleisten. Mit modularen, skalierbaren und hygienischen Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, Produktverluste zu reduzieren, Stillstandszeiten zu minimieren und die Gesamtanlageneffektivität (OEE) zu steigern. Wir sind bestrebt, unser Angebot und unsere Kompetenzen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, um den sich wandelnden Anforderungen unserer Kunden gerecht zu werden.

Weitere Informationen über Rotzinger Transver und unser umfassendes Leistungsspektrum finden Sie auf der Website: www.rotzingertransver.com.

Rotzinger Transver ist Teil von Coesia, einer weltweit tätigen Unternehmensgruppe für innovative Industrie- und Verpackungslösungen mit Hauptsitz in Bologna. Coesia ist in 34 Ländern vertreten, vereint 21 Unternehmen und beschäftigt per 2026 mehr als 8'000 Mitarbeitende weltweit.

Über die Rolle

Als Head of Project Management (m/w/d) übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für das Projektportfolio an unseren Produktionsstandorten in Kaiseraugst und Altendorf. Sie führen ein Team von Project Managern und sorgen für die erfolgreiche Umsetzung unserer internationalen Kundenprojekte. Dabei treiben Sie die Weiterentwicklung des Projektmanagements aktiv voran und tragen dazu bei, Projekte effizienter, transparenter und profitabler umzusetzen.

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Applications for this position will be accepted on an ongoing basis.

We are Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI + Data + CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer too, driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good, you've come to the right place.

About the Role

Production leadership required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

 

Salesforce is hiring a Portfolio Leader to directly manage and grow a team of technical AI specialists deploying Agentforce solutions inside complex customer environments. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can drive engineering excellence while operating at the executive level. This is not a traditional people manager, but a mission-critical multiplier on the agentic frontier. You will lead a blended delivery team made up of two specialist functions: Forward Deployed Engineers (Technical Builders - who design, build, and deploy AI Agents directly in customer environments) and Deployment Strategists (Strategic Builders - customer-facing advisors who shape AI strategy, define use cases, and drive adoption). Together, these teams work alongside customers to co-build and deliver agentic AI solutions on a single large enterprise account or across multiple engagements simultaneously. You'll set the engineering standards, unblock complex customer deployments, and scale the talent that's shipping production AI today. 

The Builder Leadership Experience

Delivery Team Coordination: You own the capacity planning, talent acquisition, and staffing that ensures your cross-functional squads have the horsepower to deploy Agentforce at enterprise scale. 

AI-Augmented Leadership: Your team ships solutions using a best-in-class suite of AI tools (Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes). You will foster an inclusive, high-energy, and psychologically safe engineering culture where builders iterate fast and continuously level up.

Direct Product Influence: You stand at the center of the product feedback loop. Partner directly with the Product and Engineering organizations on pilot programs and beta rollouts, turning raw field insights from high-stakes deployments into features on the Agentforce core roadmap.

What You'll Actually Be Building & Execution

Leadership & Team Excellence

Scale Elite Talent: Recruit, mentor, and develop the next wave of Technical and Strategic Builders. Drive technical excellence, structure career growth, and foster an environment where shipping high-quality, production-ready systems is the norm.

Maintain Operational Velocity: Monitor key delivery metrics, coach your teams on optimization, and run hard on complex customer escalations. You ensure your teams move from sketch to deployable in weeks, not months.

Technical Strategy & Authority

Ultimate Technical Authority: Serve as the final technical escalation point for your portfolio. Maintain deep architectural judgment across the Salesforce platform, advanced LLM techniques, data pipelines, and agentic orchestration.

Guide Enterprise Implementations: Unblock complex data readiness, tool integration, and multi-agent orchestration challenges. Step in directly to help your teams assess customer technical readiness, remove deployment barriers, and codify standardized, repeatable delivery methodologies.

Customer & Business Impact

Drive Agentic Adoption: Build and anchor strong executive-level relationships within your customer portfolio, ensuring flawless Agentforce activation, rollout, and sustained production value.

Accelerate Portfolio Performance: Operationally run your account portfolio with engineering rigor - monitoring health, delivery velocity, and core consumption metrics to accelerate progress toward customer business outcomes.

Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner lock-step with Services, Account Success, and Product teams to help enterprises activate and consume Agentforce quickly, moving customers from pilot to production at hyper-speed.

You're Our Builder Lead If…

You Have Proven Leadership: 4+ years of direct people management or high-impact technical leadership steering cross-functional engineering or technical teams. You have a track record of hiring, mentoring, and scaling technical talent.

You Bring Advanced Technical Depth: Deep architectural understanding of AI, LLMs, and the Salesforce ecosystem. You have hands-on experience with enterprise software implementation, data modeling, API integration, and AI deployments.

You Own the Agentforce & Data Cloud Blueprint: You possess direct, hands-on experience architecting or deploying Salesforce Data Cloud and the Agentforce platform. You don't just understand the tech stack - you know how to orchestrate it to unblock enterprise scale and drive immediate production value.

You Lead with an Enterprise Customer Focus: Strong background navigating high-touch customer strategies at a Global level, paired with exceptional executive-level communication and influence skills. You can hold your own in a room with customer CTOs and enterprise architects.

You Have a Ship-It Mindset: Exceptional problem-solving instincts, extreme resourcefulness, and a "get-things-done" demeanor. You thrive at the technical helm where code is being actively shipped, not just talking about it.

Nice-to-Haves

Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems, prompt engineering pipelines, or deterministic AI guardrails.

Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery) and enterprise data pipelines.

Relevant Salesforce certifications (Advanced Admin, Service Cloud, Data Cloud, Sales Cloud, or Agentforce Specialist).

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Job Description:

The Role:

Entegris is seeking a Senior Director, Enterprise Portfolio Management Office (EPMO) to lead portfolio governance, demand management, and delivery oversight for strategic technology and digital transformation initiatives. 

This leader will partner closely with business and technology executives to ensure investments are aligned to company priorities, appropriately funded and resourced, and delivered in a predictable manner. This leader will establish the processes and governance required to move initiatives efficiently from idea through execution and value realization while driving transparency, accountability, and business outcomes across the portfolio. 

The ideal candidate combines strong portfolio and program leadership experience with the ability to influence executive decision-making, lead organizational change, and improve the effectiveness of enterprise technology investments. 

This position reports directly to the Chief Information & Digital Officer. It will be based local to one of our hubs, ideally in Chaska, MN, Bedford, MA, or Aurora, IL.

 

What You’ll Do:

Enterprise Portfolio Leadership & Governance

Lead the Enterprise Portfolio Management Office (EPMO), establishing portfolio management, governance, and delivery practices that enable successful execution of strategic initiatives.

Oversee enterprise portfolio governance, prioritization, funding, and investment decision-making to ensure alignment with business objectives and organizational capacity.

Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on portfolio strategy, investment priorities, risks, and tradeoffs.

Demand Management & Portfolio Prioritization

Own the enterprise demand management process, providing a transparent framework for evaluating, prioritizing, and approving technology and digital investments.

Lead the end-to-end portfolio lifecycle from intake and business case development through execution and value realization.

Develop portfolio metrics and reporting that provide visibility into demand, capacity, delivery performance, and investment outcomes.

Resource Planning & Portfolio Optimization

Lead enterprise-wide capacity planning and resource forecasting to balance demand, funding, and organizational readiness.

Facilitate executive decision-making regarding investment priorities, resource allocation, and portfolio tradeoffs.

Continuously evaluate portfolio performance and recommend adjustments to maximize business value and delivery effectiveness.

Strategic Program Oversight

Provide executive oversight for large-scale, cross-functional technology and business transformation initiatives.

Ensure effective risk management, governance, financial stewardship, and delivery

Executive Reporting & Value Realization

Provide executive leadership with a consolidated view of portfolio performance, investment health, risks, and realized business value.

Establish value realization measures and drive continuous improvement across portfolio management, governance, and delivery practices.

Organizational Leadership & PMO Maturity

Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement while advancing portfolio management capabilities across the enterprise.

Champion organizational change management and PMO best practices to improve adoption, efficiency, and business outcomes.

Demonstrated success leading an Enterprise PMO, Portfolio Management Office, or comparable function within a complex global organization.

Extensive experience managing strategic technology portfolios, enterprise transformation initiatives, and portfolio governance processes.

Strong expertise in demand management, prioritization, resource planning, investment management, and value realization.

Deep understanding of portfolio, program, project, Agile, and product delivery methodologies.

Proven ability to influence executive decision-making and build strong partnerships across business and technology functions.

Strong business and financial acumen, including business case development, budgeting, forecasting, and investment planning.

Demonstrated success leading organizational change, improving operating models, and driving measurable business outcomes.

Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Broad understanding of enterprise business processes and supporting technologies across key functional areas.

Outstanding Candidates Will Have:

Master's degree in business administration, Information Systems, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.

10+ years of progressive leadership experience in portfolio, program, or project management.

Experience leading enterprise portfolios and large-scale digital or business transformation initiatives.

Experience transforming PMO organizations and advancing portfolio management maturity.

Relevant certifications such as PMP, PgMP, PfMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, or equivalent.

Demonstrated track record of delivering measurable business value through technology investments and operational excellence.

Lead. Inspire. Innovate. Define Your Future.

Not everyone who works for a global company shares the same background, experiences and perspectives. We leverage the differences of our employees to bring new ideas to the table. We put our values at the core of how we operate as an organization — not just when it’s convenient, but in a lasting and meaningful way. title: Product Management Director – Soft FM & Estates (UK)
description:
About SINGU

At SINGU, we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.

 

Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide, supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries — and we’re just getting started.

 

Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.

 

If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation.

About the Role

You'll own a significant slice of the SINGU product suite: space management and Soft FM services – cleaning standards, portering, and catering – used every day primarily across the UK healthcare market. Product-market fit is established and thousands of users depend on these products daily. What the portfolio needs now is strategic direction and taking them to their next level of growth.

You'll do that through a team of four Product Managers who are domain experts in the products they run. This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll stay close to customer problems yourself, you'll raise the bar on how the team discovers and validates work, and you'll have real autonomy to decide what's worth building – and to prove it works.

SINGU group grows both organically and through acquisition, and several of these products arrived with the companies that built them. You'll shape the strategy for bringing them into one coherent ecosystem and lead your team through that change. If you enjoy taking a set of good but separate products and making them add up to something bigger, that is the interesting part of this job.

You'll partner closely with Sales, Engineering, and Product colleagues across the SINGU Group so your portfolio drives revenue and solves real problems across the European FM market. AI is a must-have lever in our industry rather than a talking point: you'll be applying it where it measurably improves how our customers run their estates.

This is a remote position with periodic travel to London and Kraków – roughly every two to four weeks.

Role Scope

People Leadership & Team Development:

  • Manage and develop the Product Managers within the product team.

  • Own the full management lifecycle: hiring, onboarding, mentorship, feedback, coaching, performance evaluations, promotions, and exits.

  • Foster a high-performing product culture based on customer empathy, data-driven decision-making, and outcome orientation.

  • Manage staffing and focus areas across the suite, reallocating product resources where needed to balance discovery workload and meet strategic priorities.

  • Lead the team through change – new ways of working, a shifting portfolio, and product consolidation – bringing people with you rather than around them.

Product Discovery & Strategy:

  • Define and maintain product roadmaps aligned with business objectives, customer needs, and market trends.

  • Decide where to invest and where to hold: set a clear, defensible position on which initiatives scale and communicate it across the business.

  • Build strong alignment with the Sales team to ensure product discovery and roadmap priorities actively unblock deals and support revenue growth.

  • Identify and resolve ambiguities, dependencies, and competing priorities that impact discovery quality and speed.

Product Management Best Practices & Standards:

  • Promote modern product practices, including continuous discovery, outcome-based roadmapping, and hypothesis-driven development.

  • Ensure product teams consistently validate assumptions through user research, experimentation, and data analysis.

  • Drive improvements in requirements quality, stakeholder communication, prioritization frameworks, and release planning.

  • Cooperate with the Chief Architect and Engineering Managers to ensure product decisions account for technical feasibility and platform constraints.

  • Drive the adoption of AI-powered tools and analytics to improve product insights, customer understanding, and decision-making quality.

Collaboration & Cross-Company Coordination:

  • Coordinate with commercial and customer-facing teams to align product strategy with go-to-market plans and revenue goals for the portfolio.

  • Represent the company at external events, conferences, and industry forums to share product insights, build the Group's profile, and stay connected to market trends.

  • Maintain alignment, knowledge sharing, and team cohesion with colleagues across the Group.

Experience & Requirements

Must have's:

  • 5+ years in product management, ideally with at least three of them in B2B SaaS. Strong B2C experience in FM, healthcare, or an adjacent domain is also worth a conversation.

  • At least two years leading a team as a people manager – product managers ideally, but we are flexible on the setup; what matters is that you have owned a team, not that you are ready to start.

  • Experience taking a team or a product area through real change: new ways of working, a restructure, or post-acquisition integration – and bringing the sceptics with you.

  • Demonstrable experience applying AI within product development, using AI-powered tooling to accelerate discovery and delivery.

  • Proven track record of leading product discovery across multiple methods and translating insights into validated roadmaps.

  • Strong commercial awareness: able to partner with Sales and align product decisions with revenue and retention goals.

  • Data fluency: comfortable defining metrics, querying product analytics, and using quantitative evidence to drive decisions.

  • Excellent stakeholder communication: able to frame trade-offs and build alignment across technical and non-technical audiences.

  • English at C1 or above, written and spoken, with the confidence to represent the product externally.

Nice to Have's:

  • Experience working in empowered product trios (or similar cross-functional squads) with engineering and design.

  • Experience in healthcare (ideally the UK market, NHS), public sector, or government-adjacent markets.

  • Familiarity with platform or multi-product portfolio environments.

  • Experience integrating acquired products into a single coherent platform.

  • Polish or German alongside English.

Not sure you tick every box? If you are strong on product leadership and craft but light on one of the requirements, we would still like to hear from you.

Why Here

  • Real ownership: you own a portfolio and the team that runs it. Strategy, discovery, and outcomes are yours, not a backlog handed down to you.

  • Modern product culture: we work in trios, practice continuous discovery, and ship to learn.

  • AI that makes sense: you'll apply AI to a platform customers already rely on, where it measurably improves how they run their estates – not bolted on for its own sake.

  • A stable base for ambitious work: SINGU is profitable and growing, with consistently stable results.

  • Growth: SINGU keeps growing through acquisition, so new areas to consolidate and lead keep appearing.

  • International scope: five companies and around 250 people across Poland, the UK, and Germany, with a portfolio that spans markets rather than one office.

If this role sounds like a good fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply and help us build technology that supports critical operations every day.

title: Energy Scheduling & Portfolio Lead
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We are hiring an Energy Scheduling & Portfolio Lead to own energy availability across Anthropic's non-cloud data center portfolio: contracted and available energy against planned compute, and the risk to it. This one central scheduling and portfolio role holds the live view of energy availability risk and energy availability need for workload management. You will be our counterpart to the LSEs, QSEs, scheduling coordinators, and suppliers in electricity and gas markets across jurisdictions; forecasting is an instrument of that view. You schedule and manage physical energy delivery — not financial instruments — including how much gas the portfolio needs to schedule, and keep energy supply and the workload plan in step with workload and site planning, energy origination, and data center operations. ESA counterparties operate the behind-the-meter plants; you manage their performance and our exposure. This role will also build processes and structures to ultimately support asset management across our energy portfolio. You are this function's first dedicated owner and will build its models and processes from zero.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the live view of energy availability risk and need: contracted, available, and committed energy and capacity at each site against planned load and ramp, by month and by hour where it matters; keep it current as deals sign, sites come online, and plans change, and close gaps and use surpluses with workload and site planning and energy origination.

  • Be the operational counterpart to our LSEs, QSEs, scheduling coordinators, and retail and wholesale suppliers in domestic ISO/RTOs, including ERCOT, and international power markets, and manage our participation in utility and ISO market programs.

  • Predict and track curtailment (utility, ISO, fuel, equipment, and contract-driven) for each site, and navigate shortage pricing and reliability events: ISO scarcity pricing, emergency procedures, conservation calls, and the notification and performance obligations under each ESA, PPA, utility agreement, and market program; coordinate the load response with site operations and workload planning, and track performance, compensation, and cost.

  • Oversee the portfolio's contracted or tariff-based load-flexibility capability and the contribution of this capability to Anthropic's ratepayer-protection commitment: curtailment and demand-response participation, flexible-interconnection and non-firm service commitments to utilities and ISOs, and the site-level playbooks for each; work with workload planning on what the compute can actually flex, and commit only where the workload plan supports it.

  • For the first operating sites, manage counterparty performance and Anthropic's exposure under the ESAs: outage notices, availability guarantees, liquidated damages, dispatch coordination, and the reporting behind them. Know the ESAs and utility load agreements we sign well enough to operate their scheduling, curtailment, availability, flexibility, and ratepayer-protection terms, and partner with legal and energy origination so new agreements are operable.

  • Determine how much gas the portfolio needs to schedule and build the portfolio's gas scheduling strategy for gas-fired behind-the-meter supply, nominations, hub and index pricing, pipeline capacity and constraints, and work through gas-plant outages and their effect on site availability, including by building relationships with external commodity partners.

  • Build Anthropic's energy forecasting as an instrument of the availability-risk view: consumption per site from the workload plan, site design, and ramp, and cost against ESA and PPA terms, market and natural gas prices, as the monthly and annual outputs the team and Finance need, including exposure to index-priced volume and the inputs energy origination needs to size new supply. Supply the energy-side inputs and checks that let Finance, Accounting, and Procurement Ops reconcile invoices and settlements against ESA, PPA, and tariff terms and explain the variance; this role will collaborate heavily with energy finance but will not have primary responsibility for financial management of the energy portfolio — the physical position is yours. Track the market information that moves our position — ISO/RTO prices, scarcity and reliability conditions, gas hub prices, ancillary and capacity costs, and tariff, interconnection, and market rule changes — and reflect it in the view.

  • Work cross-functionally: with energy finance on the financial management of the portfolio, with data center operations on site load, flexibility, and outages, and with other internal teams — workload and site planning, engineering and design, legal, procurement — so the energy position and the physical reality of each site stay aligned. Build and own the processes, data, and tooling for all of the above; partner with engineering and site operations on metering, telemetry, and load data so the availability view, forecasts, and settlements rest on measured consumption.

You may be a good fit if you:

  • Have 8+ years in energy markets, power scheduling, energy procurement, or utility / retail energy operations, including hands-on work with scheduling and settlement review in ERCOT, PJM, NYISO, MISO, or another ISO/RTO market.

  • Have worked at or directly with an LSE, QSE, scheduling coordinator, retail energy provider, or load-management desk, and know day-ahead and real-time scheduling, settlements, and curtailment / demand-response programs from the inside.

  • Read ESAs, PPAs, and utility large-load interconnection and service agreements fluently enough to operate their scheduling, availability, curtailment, and pricing terms and to model the exposure they create.

  • Can predict curtailment for a large load and navigate shortage pricing and reliability events — ISO scarcity pricing, emergency procedures, conservation calls — from experience, not from the rulebook.

  • Understand gas scheduling — nominations, hub pricing, pipeline constraints — and have worked through gas-fired plant outages and their effect on served load.

  • Have designed or operated load flexibility for a large load — curtailment, demand response, non-firm or flexible interconnection — and understand the large-load tariff provisions that protect other ratepayers (minimum demand charges, cost allocation, exit and stranded-cost provisions, study and collateral requirements) and how a load operates within them.

  • Have built or run energy consumption and cost forecasts for large loads — data centers, industrials, or a retail / wholesale portfolio — and can tie a forecast to contract terms and market prices.

  • Coordinate well across teams that do not report to you — workload planning, site operations, finance, legal, origination — and can give a clear picture of where energy availability stands against need and where it is at risk.

  • Have stood up a scheduling, portfolio, or operations function from scratch and built the models and processes it runs on.

  • Possess a bachelor's degree in a relevant domain (e.g., engineering, economics, energy, finance, data science) or equivalent practical experience.

It's a bonus if you have:

  • Experience with data center or other large, fast-ramping load in ERCOT, PJM, NYISO, MISO, or another ISO/RTO market.

  • Experience with behind-the-meter, islanded, or bridge-power configurations and how they schedule and settle differently from grid-served load, including managing counterparty performance under an ESA or tolling agreement — availability guarantees, outage reporting, liquidated damages, dispatch coordination.

  • Familiarity with hedging and risk management of energy cost — fixed-price, index, shaped, and block products — and with how hedges sit against physical consumption, enough to work fluently with Finance on it.

  • Familiarity with natural gas markets and hub pricing, with an emphasis on physical scheduling at regional basis hubs, gas-price indices, pipeline nominations and capacity.

  • Experience with energy data and metering systems, interval data, and building forecasting models from them.

  • Exposure to the regulatory and public-affairs side of large-load service — large-load tariff proceedings, interconnection rulemakings, or utility rate cases — and to utility and ISO demand-response, curtailment, and flexible-interconnection programs.

  • Prior experience standing up an operations or analytics function in a growing team.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$320,000—$405,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

About the Team

The User Operations team (Support) is central to ensuring that our customers' experience with our products is nothing short of exceptional. We resolve complex issues, provide technical guidance, and support customers in maximizing value and adoption from deploying our products. We work closely with Sales, Technical Success, Product, Engineering and others to deliver the best possible experience to our customers at scale. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage startups to established global enterprises. 

About the Role

OpenAI’s top-of-funnel is evolving into a signal-driven, data-orchestrated engine powered by AI-native workflows, enriched customer intelligence, and increasingly interconnected systems. We are looking for a Technical Systems Program Manager to help drive the strategy, alignment, prioritization, and execution of these systems across Salesforce and adjacent platforms.

This role will partner closely with Engineering, Revenue Operations, Data, and Enterprise Platform teams to operationalize scalable CRM workflows. The ideal candidate combines strong technical fluency, operational systems thinking, and stakeholder leadership with the ability to drive execution across highly cross-functional environments.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA, and the team works a hybrid schedule (Monday - Wednesday in office). We will offer relocation assistance if needed. 

In this role, you will:

Own and drive CRM systems initiatives across support

Partner with senior business stakeholders and engineering teams to identify operational pain points, define scalable solutions, evaluate technical tradeoffs, and execute across Salesforce and adjacent platforms

Align cross-functional stakeholders including Revenue Operations, Support Delivery, Risk, Engineering, Data, Legal, and Enterprise Platform teams while driving prioritization and execution 

Help operationalize AI-native workflows by defining and building scalable automation, orchestration, agentic workflows, and human-in-the-loop processes in partnership with cross-functional teams

 

You might thrive in this role if you have:

You have 8+ years of experience driving high-impact technical programs in a program management, technical program management or adjacent role

Strong understanding of CRM workflows customer systems supporting user operations or support organizations

Experience working across CRM systems, routing engines, and adjacent systems

Proven ability to drive complex cross-functional initiatives from discovery and stakeholder alignment through execution and operationalization

Strong technical fluency across APIs, integrations, event-driven architectures, enterprise SaaS ecosystems, and Salesforce platform capabilities 

Experience partnering closely with Engineering, Revenue Operations, Security, and Enterprise Platform teams

Experience operating within SOX/SOC2-controlled environments with strong understanding of SDLC, QA, release management, and operational governance

Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly communicate priorities, tradeoffs, risks, and execution plans

Nice to Have

Ability to independently reason through technical system design, integration dependencies, and operational tradeoffs alongside engineering teams

Experience working within AI-native, high-growth, or highly ambiguous operating environments

Exposure to global support operations

Ability to operate scrappily and iteratively while maintaining a strong bias toward scalability, governance, and long-term maintainability

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. title: Senior Accessibility Program Manager
description:
About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, United States

Overview

At GitHub, our mission is to accelerate human progress through developer collaboration. We believe people with disabilities should benefit from that progress and directly contribute to the creation of it. 

 

We are seeking a forward-thinking, determined and innovative individual, who is passionate about the intersection of accessibility and technology, to help implement our accessibility strategy, which can be found at accessibility.github.com. This role will report directly to the Head of Accessibility and will be empowered to drive change internally and externally. 

 

 The successful candidate will:

  • Have a deep understanding of accessibility, assistive technologies, and the ways that people with disabilities interact with technology.
  • Have technical expertise that is grounded in professional experience as a software developer or designer.
  • Have hands-on experience using AI and automation to improve accessibility at scale.
  • Have professional experience managing accessibility initiatives within a large matrixed organization.
  • Have a proven track record of delivering results that empower people with disabilities to use technology. 

Responsibilities

 The goals of the GitHub accessibility program are to: 

  • Empower GitHub employees to do the best work of their lives by creating an accessible work environment with internal guides and support for procurement processes.

  • Empower developers with disabilities to build on GitHub by including their input throughout the development process, cultivating a culture of accessibility within GitHub, and driving accountability at scale.

  • Empower our customers to meet their accessibility goals when building on GitHub by aggressively dogfooding the latest GitHub platform and AI features to run our internal accessibility program, Open-sourcing our internal tools when appropriate, and sharing best practices externally.

  • Help improve the accessibility of open source by empowering people with disabilities to contribute, improving the availability and adoption of open-source Assistive Technologies, and improving the accessibility of mainstream open-source projects. 

The Senior Accessibility Program Manager may contribute to all of those program goals over time. That said, their initial focus will include, but is not limited to:

  • Manage listening systems including inclusive user research and feedback processes.
  • Build an accessibility community of practice within our Enterprise customer community.
  • Grow the capabilities of the open-source GitHub accessibility scanner and accelerate adoption by customers and open-source communities. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications :

  • 7+ years experience in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR), sustainability, accessibility engineering and design, or related area 

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Business, Sustainability, Computer Science, Communications/Marketing, or related field AND 5+ years experience in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR), sustainability, accessibility engineering and design, or related area 

    • OR Master's Degree in Business, Sustainability, Computer Science, Communications/Marketing, or related field AND 3+ years experience in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR), sustainability, accessibility engineering and design, or related area

    • OR Doctorate in Business, Sustainability, Computer Science, Communications/Marketing, or related field AND 1+ year(s) experience in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR), sustainability, accessibility engineering and design, or related area

    • OR equivalent experience

  • 3+ years of relevant experience driving programs or initiatives across organizational boundaries in a large organization.
  • 3+ years of experience evaluating the conformance of web content against the Web Content Accessibility guidelines.
  • 1+ years of hands-on experience using AI and automation to improve accessibility at scale. 

 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience developing accessible web-based user interfaces using JavaScript and modern web technologies.
  • Experience collecting and interpreting data for performance metrics and compliance.
  • Understanding of product road mapping and experience working with product and engineering teams to embed new features into roadmap plans. 

We encourage people with lived experience to apply. 


Compensation Range

The base salary range for this job is USD $103,200.00 - USD $273,700.00 /Yr.

These pay ranges are intended to cover roles based across the United States. An individual's base pay depends on various factors including geographical location and review of experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant.
