Overview

GitHub is seeking a detail-oriented individual contributor with a technical bent and experience in technical risk management who is driven to deepen that expertise. GitHub is committed to doing right by our customers and developing a highly effective control environment where risk is managed in a meaningful and sensible way that aligns with our business. 

  • Do you love the challenge of diving into the details and learning why and how things work? 

  • Do you find yourself always asking what would have to go wrong, and how badly? 

  • Do you want to see The Big Picture, and find ways to collect and organize data to tell the story? 

  • Do you suffer from a compulsive need to document things and “get it down on paper”? 

  • And last, but most certainly not least, have you already answered the question “Why are we here?” with the GRC Truth, “Because Customers”? 

 

If so, you might be the person we are looking for! 

 

As part of GRC’s Entity Risk function, you will join the Technical Risk team and partner with engineering, security, and product subject-matter experts and leaders across GitHub to conduct capability risk assessments, develop and quantify risk scenarios, and deliver meaningful risk reporting that helps leaders make risk-informed decisions. 

Central to the team's culture is that of inclusion, transparency, and teamwork - we lift each other up to be successful! This is an excellent opportunity for an independent contributor to have a hand in elevating risk management and security as business and sales enabler as well as integrate a deeper understanding of risk management into the product and business space. 


Responsibilities

  • Lead security capability risk assessments for assigned areas, including scoping against NIST CSF subcategories, coordinating schedules and stakeholder interviews, completing maturity scoring, and publishing assessment reports. 

  • Analyze data from multiple sources to identify, analyze, and prioritize technical risks, develop and quantify FAIR-style cyber risk scenarios, evaluate capabilities against established frameworks, and assess potential impacts to GitHub – our products, services, customers, and business objectives. 

  • Partner with engineering, security, and product subject-matter experts and leaders to validate findings, identify risk patterns, and translate technical insights and stakeholder feedback into practical risk recommendations. 

  • Develop and manage risk treatment plans, drive adoption of appropriate mitigations and remediation, monitor treatment progress, and escalate unresolved or emerging risks. 

  • Maintain the risk register and supporting records in GitHub’s GRC system of record, track mitigation progress, and provide clear, recurring risk updates to technical and non-technical leaders.

    • o OR Doctorate AND 1+ year(s) experience in security analysis, security research, cyber security, security engineering, software engineering, or relevant area
    • o OR equivalent experience.

  • 5+ years experience applying security or control frameworks, such as NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, or ISO/IEC 27001. 

  • 5+ years experience in technical risk management, information security, audit, or compliance. 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience applying cyber risk quantification (CRQ) using FAIR or a comparable quantitative risk analysis method, including developing risk scenarios and estimating loss event frequency and loss magnitude to produce defensible loss exposure ranges that express risk in financial terms and support risk-informed investment and risk-acceptance decisions.  

  • Experience with GRC platforms used to maintain risk registers and risk treatment plans (ZenGRC, ServiceNow GRC, Archer, or comparable). 

  • Experience building risk reporting, metrics, or automation using Azure Data Explorer (Kusto/KQL), Excel, Google Sheets, SQL, Python, or comparable tools.

At Quantum Systems, we develop advanced autonomous systems for defense and security across multiple domains, combining unmanned platforms with integrated software and AI. As Senior Manager Business Ethics, Speak-up & Investigations, you will play a key role in building and strengthening Quantum Systems’ Group Ethics & Compliance programme. You will take end-to-end functional ownership for Business Ethics, Anti-Bribery & Corruption, Speak-up and Internal Investigations.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with clear functional ownership and no direct people-management responsibility at present. As part of the integrated Governance, Risk & Compliance organization, you will work across Risk Governance, Ethics & Compliance, ESG and Group Assurance to help establish effective and scalable governance.

You will independently develop, implement and manage the assigned programmes, frameworks and processes, translating the Group Integrity Framework into practical standards, controls and guidance. Working closely with relevant corporate functions, you will help prevent misconduct, respond credibly to potential violations and build a risk-based, scalable Compliance Management System for our growing international defense-technology business.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Own and continuously enhance the Group Business Ethics & Integrity Program, covering the Code of Conduct, Anti-Bribery & Corruption, Conflicts of Interest, Gifts & Hospitality, Donations and Sponsorships, ethical decision-making and non-retaliation.

  • Establish and implement policies, standards, guidance and processes, supported by risk-based training, communications and advice that enable practical application across the Group.

Join Apaleo and shape the future of hospitality tech 

Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure lets hoteliers customise their tech stack, automate routine work and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay. 

If you're driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you. 

 

About the role 

You'll join our Platform team as an individual contributor working closely with our Principal Engineer, who leads Platform's technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering org, so this is a high-ownership seat: you'll take on large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives and drive them from first analysis through to completion, with real autonomy over how you get there. 

We don't run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a big topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn't the role; if you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you'll fit right in. 

 

What you'll be up to 

  • Architecting and developing scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems. 
  • Self-identifying and scoping problems and initiatives, not just executing assigned tickets: assessing impact, prioritisation and timing independently. 
  • Leading architectural decisions and design discussions with cross-team alignment. 
  • Driving large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, including coordination with multiple stakeholders. 
  • Mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence. 
  • Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that empower teams to deliver faster and more reliably. 
  • Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available. 
  • Participating in on-call rotations and stepping in as a reliable problem solver during incidents. 
  • Proactively spotting where AI and automation can drive technical improvement. 

 

Some of the challenges waiting for you 

  • Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database (we already scale reads horizontally). 
  • Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery. 
  • Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform, including the ability to recreate an Apaleo environment from scratch. 
  • Extracting and reworking common services (like shared schedulers) to get us ready for our next scale level. 

 

What you'll bring to the team 

  • 8+ years of backend development experience, including several years in a staff-level or technical leadership role. 
  • Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms: we care more about how you think than which stack you've used. 
  • A track record of owning large technical initiatives from ambiguity through to completion, ideally on a platform or infrastructure team rather than a pure product team. 
  • Experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred; strong Azure fundamentals with genuine enthusiasm for the switch work just as well). 
  • Comfortable working with containerised services and infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Terraform; CloudFormation exposure is relevant given our current stack). 
  • Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests: we don't have a dedicated QA function. 
  • Fluent English. 

Nice to have 

  • Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS/Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong. 
  • Experience setting up infrastructure-as-code from scratch and working with it day to day, ideally with Terraform, including migrating or consolidating from other IaC approaches (like CloudFormation). 
  • Experience with Kafka or other event-driven and streaming systems (Azure Service Bus experience is a good transferable equivalent). 
  • Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Amazon CodeWhisperer) and a genuine interest in AI-driven engineering improvement. 
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, particularly for introducing new technology, like AI tooling, to other teams.

  • Growth and development: 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and an evolving career framework. 
  • Autonomy and ownership: we empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly in an environment built on trust and transparency. 
  • Shape the future of hospitality tech: your work drives real impact from day one, at a fast-growing scale-up. 
  • Competitive and fair compensation, guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. 

 

Perks and lifestyle 

  • Flexible and remote work options: office, home or hybrid, based on what works for your role and team. 
  • A fully covered Deutschland Ticket for free public transport across Germany. 
  • Regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties and other offsite events. 
  • 30 days of paid holiday to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired. 
  • An EGYM Wellpass membership giving access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options. 

 

Where you'll work from 

This role is based in Munich, with hybrid working from our office there. We're also open to remote within Germany, or remote via an Employer of Record for candidates based outside in the EU/ Europe.

We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

We are seeking a senior Real Estate Portfolio Manager to join Anthropic's Workplace and Real Estate team to lead strategic planning, portfolio optimization, and a team of real estate professionals across our global footprint. This high-impact role will develop comprehensive real estate strategies, conduct rigorous market and financial analyses, and deliver executive-level recommendations to our CFO and senior leadership. The Real Estate Portfolio Manager will oversee a team including a Real Estate Program Manager and an Occupancy Planning/Lease Administration specialist, building a high-performing function that brings the strategic rigor and analytical sophistication of established corporate real estate organizations to our rapidly scaling AI company.

Responsibilities:

Strategy & Executive Communication

  • Develop comprehensive real estate strategy documents that synthesize market analysis, financial modeling, and location recommendations for CFO and executive leadership review

  • Lead strategic portfolio planning including scenario modeling for growth, market entry/exit decisions, and long-term footprint optimization

  • Create executive-level presentations and decision memos that translate complex real estate data into clear strategic recommendations

  • Conduct in-depth market analyses including competitive positioning, labor market dynamics, talent availability, and cost-of-occupancy comparisons across target markets

  • Build and maintain sophisticated financial models for real estate decisions including NPV analysis, lease vs. buy scenarios, and total cost of occupancy projections

  • Partner with Finance on capital planning, real estate budgeting, and investment justification for major portfolio decisions

Portfolio & Program Oversight

  • Develop location strategy frameworks that align real estate decisions with business unit requirements, talent strategy, and corporate objectives

  • Oversee occupancy planning and demand forecasting efforts, translating headcount projections into actionable space requirements and timing recommendations

  • Direct lease administration strategy including portfolio risk assessment, lease restructuring opportunities, and critical obligation management

  • Establish portfolio performance metrics and reporting frameworks that provide executive visibility into real estate investments and outcomes

  • Partner with external advisors (brokers, consultants, legal) to execute strategic initiatives and negotiate favorable terms

  • Identify portfolio optimization opportunities including consolidation, expansion, or repositioning strategies that enhance operational efficiency and reduce costs

Team Leadership

  • Manage and develop a team of two direct reports: a Real Estate Program Manager and an Occupancy Planning/Lease Administration specialist

  • Set clear goals and priorities for the team, ensuring alignment with broader real estate and company objectives

  • Provide coaching, mentorship, and professional development opportunities to build team capabilities

  • Foster a collaborative, high-performance culture that emphasizes quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

  • Allocate resources effectively across strategic initiatives and operational demands

You may be a good fit if you:

  • Have 10+ years of progressive experience in corporate real estate strategy, portfolio management, or real estate finance, with at least 3-5 years in a people management role

  • Have a proven track record of developing and presenting real estate strategies to executives

  • Possess sophisticated financial modeling skills including NPV, IRR, scenario analysis, and total cost of occupancy methodologies

  • Have deep expertise in market analysis including labor economics, competitive positioning, and location strategy development

  • Are an exceptional writer who can synthesize complex analyses into compelling strategic narratives and executive-ready documents

  • Have demonstrated success building and leading high-performing teams

  • Have experience managing portfolios of significant scale and complexity across multiple geographies

  • Can operate with autonomy and drive strategic initiatives with minimal direction

  • Have strong executive presence and can confidently present recommendations to senior leadership

  • Thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments where you can build processes and frameworks from the ground up

Strong candidates may also:

  • Have experience in high-growth technology companies navigating rapid scaling challenges

  • Hold an MBA or advanced degree in real estate, finance, or related field

  • Have relevant certifications such as CoreNet MCR or CCIM

  • Bring consulting experience from firms specializing in corporate real estate strategy

  • Have experience with international market entry and global portfolio optimization

  • Have led major strategic initiatives such as headquarters relocations, portfolio consolidations, or market expansions

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$275,000—$275,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

  • Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences.

Back-End

  • PostgreSQL (or MySQL)

  • Elasticsearch

  • Redis

Front-End

  • HTML

AI Integration

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Kubernetes for microservices orchestration

  • Graph databases for complex financial data

  • Contributions to open-source RoR or AI projects

Required Soft Skills

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech

  • Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates

  • Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality

  • Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration

Mitre Media powers premium financial brands like Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com with the Mitre Platform. This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Our data-derived insights delight users, while our advertising solutions deliver unmatched performance for partners like BlackRock and Vanguard, leveraging advanced targeting and first-party data.

How to Apply

 

Submit your resume, GitHub profile, and a brief note on why you’re excited about building AI-driven FinTech to jobs@mitremedia.com.

description:

Lead, scope, and operationalize cross-functional programs and projects involving multiple stakeholders with limited oversight.

Description

The Energy Analytics, Technical Program Manager (TPM) will scale power monitoring, insight generation, and energy and carbon reduction initiatives across Amazon's North America fulfillment operations. In this hands-on technical role, you will deploy and generate analysis from power metering infrastructure and implement load flexibility and energy optimization roadmaps that deliver measurable cost savings and carbon reductions. This work directly supports Amazon's demand-side power requirements and Climate Pledge commitments.

You will operate as an individual contributor, owning the delivery of defined and ambiguous work-streams while partnering with engineering, controls, data, operations and deployment teams to implement changes. You will influence cross-functional partners without authority, primarily at the team and management level, using data to drive decisions. You will integrate and analyze power metering information, providing load forecasts and generating cost and energy savings opportunities. Utility rate structures, time of day, demand ratchets and power factor penalties will influence your strategies. Technical assets influenced can include material handling, robotics, powered industrial trucks, lighting, heating ventilation and air conditioning, plug loads, electrical metering and more. Developed projects will be scaled across hundreds of facilities across the network, producing energy, cost and carbon benefit.

Key job responsibilities

● Build and execute technical solutions for energy and carbon reduction from pilot, data collection, through scaled implementation and measurement & verification (M&V) of results.  Energy and load optimization via control systems is a technical requirement: energy-conservation/standby modes, variable speed applications, and equipment scheduling.

● Drive continuous monitoring and energy efficiency improvements with Amazon's energy consuming assets.  Integrate power metering into our data sets, and develop analytics to identify opportunities, assess trending consumption changes, and measure benefits of conservation efforts.

● Prepare written analysis of feasibility studies and recommendations for various energy monitoring and power flexibility strategies.  Own metering data quality programs, check readings for completeness, outliers, and flag actionable improvements, and reconcile against known loads to ensure trusted insight generation.

● Develop metrics, baselines, and roadmaps that translate technical work into quantified outcomes (energy savings, cost savings or utility tariff arbitrage, load forecast, reliability, carbon reduction).

● Define and own technical approach and cross-system architecture for data configuration, standards and mechanisms for scalability and enforcement of key energy savings mechanisms. Decide how to build and prove new approaches managing tradeoffs for necessary business needs, rather than executing a defined scope.

● Manage projects against plans and objectives to ensure commitments are met, delivering against our power and Climate Pledge goals.

● Deep diving (troubleshooting) and unblocking issues that are prohibiting teams from pursuing energy reduction initiatives.

● Work with critical stakeholders on developing mechanisms for design standard integration for launching facilities that incorporate energy optimization procedures from Day 1.

● Analyze and communicate the financial impact of projects and initiatives (payback, return on investment, net present value)

● Serve as a technical reviewer for peers and partner engineers — reviewing control logic, metering architecture, and design-standard changes, and improving them on technical merit

● Quantify and own value add of energy savings mechanisms and how they reduce equipment runtime and increases reliability and lifespan.

● Calculate and report energy, water and carbon savings using International Performance Measurement and Verification Protocol methodologies.

● Manage multiple, complex projects simultaneously.

● Produce clear documentation, playbooks, and reporting that make work-streams repeatable.

A day in the life

You might spend the morning querying newly integrated power-metering data and validating it against the distribution-panel hierarchy — resolving a data-quality gap — then analyzing load profiles and build an energy-savings or peak-shaving model that quantifies the opportunity by equipment class. You then define network rollout suitability and prioritize these opportunities across sites. In the afternoon you develop control logic changes to implement an efficiency opportunity, propose updates to a design standard, or define a measurement method for implemented energy and cost savings to your stakeholders. You balance trade-offs between energy savings, technical complexity, equipment reliability, and cost — bringing well-reasoned recommendations and escalating the most ambiguous decisions for alignment.

The Global Energy, Sustainability and Automation (GESA) Energy team is dedicated to delivering energy efficiency, cost savings, and demand flexibility within Amazon's fulfillment network. We partner closely with design, controls, data, procurement, operations, field engineering, and deployment teams — as well as external vendors — to ensure our energy consumption is monitored and optimized. Our focus in the coming years is scaling our energy monitoring and analytics programs, expanding behavioral and retrofit programs, expanding load flexibility for power resilience and cost arbitrage benefit, and enhancing asset reliability and lifespan through efficient operation. If you are energized by large-scale technical challenges and want to make a tangible impact on energy use, this is the team for you.

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent

- Experience in SQL Server/MySQL, or experience in Redshift and experience in any Bigdata architecture

- Experience working with existing and emerging technologies related to building energy (i.e. power metering, conveyance, robotics, controls, HVAC, charging infrastructure)

About the Team

AWS Global Energy is responsible for powering the world's most demanding cloud infrastructure. The team is organized across three verticals: Global Energy Strategy (GES), which leads the development of innovative commercial structures to meet capacity demand and AWS's carbon-free energy commitments; Power Generation Solutions (PGS), the single-threaded owner for AWS power generation and energy engineering — delivering capacity solutions aligned with AWS's availability, reliability, sustainability, and redundancy requirements and managing the production readiness lifecycle of AWS-owned or commissioned generation and storage assets; and Energy Portfolio Operations (EPO), which owns Amazon's global renewable PPA portfolio and AWS CFE supply agreements. Global Energy partners closely with regional data center planning and delivery, global sustainability, and broader Amazon business units on energy procurement and infrastructure needs.

About the Role

As a Senior Technical Program Manager on the PGS leadership team, you will report directly to the Head of Power Generation Solutions and serve as a strategic partner to PGS and Global Energy leadership. This is a dual-scope role: you will own technical program management for one of PGS's power programs, while also driving cross-cutting strategy, controllership, and operational mechanisms for PGS and the broader Global Energy organization.

You will work at the intersection of technical execution and business strategy, partnering with PGS engineering leads, Global Energy Principals, Energy Portfolio Operations, Finance, and senior AWS leadership to ensure our programs are on track, our organization is scaled appropriately, and our strategy is clear and actionable. You'll engage external partners, facilitate senior executive interactions, and serve as a trusted voice for PGS in cross-organizational forums.

This role is right for someone who thrives in ambiguity, thinks big, and can operate with equal fluency in a technical design review and a VP-level strategy session.

About You

You have a track record of delivering complex, ambiguous programs at scale — and doing it with the business acumen and executive presence to bring senior leaders along. You are data-driven but not data-bound; you know when to go deep and when to synthesize. You write clearly, speak directly, and earn trust quickly across organizational boundaries.

You are energized by consequential work. AWS's power strategy is shaping how the world's infrastructure gets built — and this role sits at the center of it.

Basic Qualifications

Experience in technical program management, strategy, or related fields in a large-scale infrastructure, energy, or technology organization

Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs with senior leadership visibility

Strong analytical skills with demonstrated ability to translate data into strategic recommendations

Key Responsibilities

Own technical program management for part of the AWS power program, including pipeline management, milestone tracking, senior leader engagement, and vendor coordination.

Partner with the Head of PGS to develop and maintain a multi-year strategic roadmap for Global Energy, translating long-term priorities into annual execution plans with clear owners and accountability mechanisms.

Lead Global Energy controllership mechanisms, including headcount and resource planning, hiring performance tracking, and operating cadence — ensuring leadership has timely, accurate visibility into organizational health and delivery status.

Develop and manage reporting for senior leadership on program status, strategic initiatives, and organizational metrics; synthesize complex inputs into clear, decision-ready narratives.

Build and maintain trusted relationships with Finance, Talent Acquisition, Human Resources, and partner delivery organizations to ensure Global Energy's full scope of needs is represented in cross-organizational planning.

Drive continuous improvement in Global Energy's operating mechanisms — identifying gaps, proposing solutions, and leading implementation across teams.

Represent PGS and Global Energy in senior forums, including facilitating off-sites, leadership reviews, and partner engagements inside and outside AWS.

Champion a high-performance team culture: model strong judgment, clear communication, and a bias for action.

To deliver these solutions, our team provides technical input to realize a shared vision and strategy with partner teams and provides engineering support across the project or product lifecycle to deliver the solution. We also provide grid analytics and manage and develop models for determining the total energy and water use within our fleet of data centers and work with partners on improving overall performance.

NVIDIA's invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. We desire a self-starter, with great communication skills; as well as a leader, with a deep sense of commitment. You will be responsible for developing wafer forecasts, schedule generation and management, supporting cross-functional teams, and mitigating any programmatic risks. The in-office requirement for this role is 5 days a week at our Santa Clara, CA headquarters. 

What you’ll be doing:

You own silicon bring-up schedule from power on to production release

Negotiate silicon and board demand with teams and drive a bottom-up forecast

Oversee and manage chip and board allocations across the company

Lead prototype chip delivery to internal customers

Track and coordinate engineering deliverables, key milestones and qualification/validation tasks in the new product introduction phase

Identify and mitigate risks to schedules and programs

Communicate status to cross-functional teams as well as upper management

Continuously evaluate internal tools and processes and drive fixes to improve productivity

Create new and fix existing processes between different teams

Drive implementation of SW tools for data analytics and process evaluation

BS degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering or related (or equivalent experience)

5+ years in Semiconductor Program Management, ASIC Product Engineering, or ASIC design

Deep understanding of ASIC Technology and Productization requirements

Strong verbal and written communication skills, and the ability to coordinate with multiple technical and business teams

Self-directed and driven, highly motivated, creative, and have a consistent record of handling multiple tasks at any given time

Have the ability to work independently and follow complex procedures

Proficient with MS Project and Excel

title: Technical Program Management
description:
About Chalk

Chalk (chalk.ai) is the platform for production AI. Trusted by enterprises including Whatnot, Grindr, Mission Lane, Turo, and Apartment List, Chalk brings together context, runtime, and learning for agents and models. Chalk’s Context Engine delivers live context by querying data across warehouses, databases, streams, and APIs, straight from the source. Chalk’s runtime powers agents and models with infrastructure and governed access to LLMs and tools. Together, these capabilities help teams build AI that understands their business, continuously improves, and runs reliably in production. We've recently raised a $50 million Series A, led by Felicis. Learn more at chalk.ai.

About the role

We are hiring our first Technical Program Manager to drive execution across Chalk's most important initiatives. Chalk's surface area is growing quickly: the Chalk Context Engine serves features to models and agents in single-digit milliseconds, and Chalk Compute runs models and agents securely inside our customers' own clouds. Every launch spans engineering, product, docs, and go-to-market, and we need someone who keeps all of it moving.

You'll work directly with our founders, VP of Product, and engineering leads to build and run our program management systems, processes, and culture. We want to move fast, and any process that slows us down should be there because it leads to better decisions and products.

We're in the office 5 days a week. When unavoidable conflicts come up, we're flexible. This is not a hybrid role.

What you will do

Drive Chalk's largest cross-functional programs end to end, including critical product launches, with complete independence

Build the program management systems, processes, and culture that change how teams think, decide, collaborate, measure progress, and deliver

Elevate the execution capability of the engineering teams around you

Own timelines, dependencies, and risks for major platform initiatives — surface tradeoffs early and drive them to decisions

KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.

Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The RAPID division is the world leading provider of reticle inspection solutions for the semiconductor industry. The company provides inspection solutions to both the mask shops and the semiconductor fabs to ensure that lithography yields are consistently high thus enabling cost-effective manufacturing.

Lead engineering development projects for mask inspection products in RAPID division of KLA  

Assess, evaluate risks, and drive projects forward with an eye for critical path

Lead, encourage, empower, and influence team members to achieve excellence in engineering rigor, reliability, usability, and customer focus  

Articulate and present execution plans for internal leadership as well as external customers

Hold regular meetings between functional groups to ensure interdependencies are well understood and documented  

Support roadmap development by detailing upcoming requirement changes and resources required

To work with pioneering technology with meaningful impact on semiconductor industry   

To work with passionate people with a diverse set of backgrounds  

To build positive relationships, and develop new skills in a high-tech environment  

To take on sophisticated and ambitious projects and succeed in the marketplace

Master or advanced degree in Engineering or Physical Sciences  

6+ years of industry experience in Engineering and/or Project Management of multidisciplinary products  

Great teammate with strong leadership, critical thinking, communication and analytical skills  

Curiosity and disposition towards learning fast beyond immediate knowledge span  

Track record for leading teams through influence rather than direct reporting line  

Experience in Capital Equipment sectors is a plus (e.g. Semiconductors, Medical Equipment, Robotics)  

Experience with Project Management tools (MS Project, Wrike, Jira, etc)  

PMP or Agile certification is a plus

With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.
 

SUMMARY

This role develops, launches and sustains complex CNC milling processes, independently delivering safe, capable, compliant and cost-effective solutions.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Independently owns complete multi-axis milling solutions from manufacturability review through CAD/CAM programming, post processing, machine setup, prove-out, FAI, validation, release and production.

Programs and optimizes complex 3-, 4- and 5-axis milling processes using advanced G/M code, Macro B and Siemens and/or Fanuc control language; diagnoses complete process and machine issues.

Leads CNC activities for new-product and process improvements; Delivers on schedule, quality, capacity and cost targets with minimal intervention or rework.

Provides expert hands-on troubleshooting and failure analysis for CNC mills and related automation, probing, laser tool-setting and multi-axis systems.

Develops and implements cutting-tool, holder and fixture strategies; demonstrates advanced tool/fixture design capability and collaborates effectively with designers, suppliers and equipment builders.

Drives equipment requirements, machine selection, vendor acceptance, installation, alignment and qualification; independently interfaces with vendors and contributes technical recommendations to site and customer manufacturing discussions.

Establishes and shares CAD/CAM and machining best practices, delivers meaningful cost and productivity improvements, and formally mentors lower-level technicians, programmers and operators.

Partners across Engineering, Operations and Maintenance; prioritize multiple assignments, communicates technical decisions and completes projects on time and with high quality.

Acts as a role model for Machine Operators in terms of attitude, machine asset care, troubleshooting, adherence to processes and decision making.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

Associate’s degree or equivalent technical certification preferred; equivalent combination of education and experience considered.

4+ years of advanced CNC programming required, including significate experience with 5-axis milling.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS REQUIREMENTS

Subject-matter-expert-level ability to take complex 5-axis surface milled components from concept through stable production using 5-axis milling best practices.

Experience deploying processes with machine probing, parametric programming, and machine calculations.

Advanced CAD/CAM proficiency, including 3D model preparation, geometry repair, fixture modeling, and toolpath generation.

Advanced Mastercam programming and multi-axis toolpath development required.

Proficiency with Fanuc ISO G/M and/or Siemens programming languages.

Proficiency with interpreting technical drawings and GD&T.

CMM data interpretation, use of complex manual gaging.

Expert troubleshooting, mentoring, technical leadership, and cross-functional collaboration.

Working knowledge of Macro B programming preferred.

Proficiency with Fanuc Robodrill and/or DMG DMP70 machining platforms preferred.

Experience integrating CNC equipment with automation systems, robotic loading, pallet systems, and machine-to-machine communication preferred.

title: Technical Program Manager, Science Operations, Code
description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to partner with Mistral's code and vibe research team - the researchers shaping how our models write, reason about, and play with code. You'll be their operational counterpart - the person who absorbs what the team is working on and makes it legible to the team, to leadership, and to adjacent teams.

This isn't a coordination role. It's a research partnership role - embedded with the team, fluent in what they're building, and operationally responsible for everything that isn't the science itself.

The ideal candidate is someone who is genuinely excited about code models. You play with them. You have opinions about what makes them feel good to use. You read the papers because you want to, not because you have to. A research background is a plus but not required - what matters is that you care about this domain and can hold your own in a room full of researchers working on it.

 

What will you do

  • Research Visibility: Partner with the team to maintain a shared, accessible view of their ongoing work - what's in flight, where it's heading, what's ready to hand off. Make the research legible to adjacent teams and leadership without pulling researchers into status work.

  • Operational Partnership: Be the team's operational partner. Handle the coordination, resourcing, and cross-team conversations that would otherwise sit on researchers' plates - so the team can stay focused on the science.

  • Research-to-release: Own the operational path from research work to release candidate for code and vibe workstreams. Partner with the release function to ensure the team's work flows cleanly into Mistral's release machinery.

  • Visibility & Communication Cadence: Code and vibe research connects to many other efforts across the organization. Keep these interfaces clean and high-signal, so the team's work integrates naturally with the wider science org.

  • Strategic Communication: Translate the team's work into clear, well-timed updates for leadership and adjacent teams - what's being built, what matters, what's coming next.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Genuine enthusiasm for code models and coding assistants - you play with them, push them, have opinions about them

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 3+ years of experience in technical program management, operations, or research coordination

  • Strong analytical skills; comfortable working in ambiguity and shaping it into structure

  • Ability to engage substantively with research work and build real credibility with technical teams

  • Excellent written and verbal communication; able to translate technical detail into clarity for different audiences


Nice to have criteria/ would be ideal if you have/are:

 

  • Experience in research-heavy or ML/AI organizations

  • Familiarity with code generation, coding agents, software engineering benchmarks, or related research areas

  • Hands-on experience with modern coding tools - you're a user, not just an observer

  • Track record of building systemic processes from the ground up

  • Comfort working in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments where priorities shift quickly

 

Why Join Us?

  • Shape how frontier AI is built and released: You’ll design and operate the systems that connect scientific discovery to real-world deployment - ensuring our work scales with clarity, reliability, and speed

  • Work inside the Science OS: Join a team building the operational backbone of Mistral’s science organization - where structure meets creativity and processes evolve through use, not bureaucracy

  • Drive visible, high-leverage impact: Your work will sit at the intersection of research, engineering, and leadership - turning complexity into alignment and enabling confident, data-informed decisions across the company

 

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

title: Senior TPM, Mathematical Software
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB
 
The Technical Program Manager, Mathematical Software and Algorithms is responsible for overseeing the development, execution, and delivery of the Battlespace Awareness software for critical programs - ensuring it meets all technical, functional, and business requirements. Battlespace Awareness software services comprise advanced algorithms for sense-making and decision-making at tactical timelines.  This role requires an individual with a strong technical background in software development, particularly in the domain of optimization and estimation, and experience managing complex projects with multiple sub-teams and many stakeholders. The Sr Technical Program Manager will be the linchpin in ensuring that the software is developed in line with the objectives defined and is released according to the planned schedule.
 
WHAT YOU'LL DO
  • Project Leadership and Strategy:
    • Develop and maintain a detailed project and execution plan - including feature development, testing and validation, deployment, and monitoring. 
    • Establish clear objectives and deliverables for the software that align with program needs.
  • Technical Expertise:
    • Maintain a deep understanding of underlying algorithms and software interfaces for battle management, threat prediction, tracking, and classification to ensure that the relevant services integrate effectively with the larger C2 system.
    • Stay updated on the latest techniques to work with subject matter experts in incorporating relevant innovations into the project plan.
  • Documentation and Process Improvement:
    • Ensure comprehensive documentation is maintained for the project, including technical specifications, user manuals, and project reports.
    • Continuously evaluate and improve project management processes to increase efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Release Management:
    • Oversee the planning and execution of the software release process, ensuring that deployment is carried out smoothly and efficiently.
    • Ensure that all software releases meet the defined quality standards before deployment.
  • Stakeholder Communication:
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for all project-related communications, internally across teams and externally with stakeholders.
    • Regularly update stakeholders on project status, risks, and milestones through reports and presentations.
  • Resource Allocation:
    • Assess and allocate necessary resources, including personnel, software, and hardware, to ensure the project is adequately supported.
    • Monitor resource utilization and make adjustments as needed to avoid bottlenecks or resource constraints.
  • Risk Management:
    • Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies with the subject matter experts to minimize impact on the project timeline and deliverables.
    • Regularly review and update the risk management plan to reflect changes in the project landscape.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:
    • Work with other divisions and departments to ensure software supports the program priorities and meets all integration requirements.
    • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration between the Battlespace Awareness business line and other stakeholders to promote a unified approach to program execution.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Extensive project management experience, preferably in software development.
  • Demonstrable understanding of optimization, applied probability, and AI/ML technology.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Experience with tools like JIRA, Confluence, and GitHub
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage high-pressure situations and tight deadlines.
  • Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. security clearance.

PREFERRED QAULIFICATIONS:

  • Familiarity and experience working with materiel leadership or mission partners within Army Air & Missile Defense, USMC Ground Based Air Defense, SOCOM, DHS CBP, or allied defense organizations and working knowledge of the counter-UAS and air surveillance competitive landscape.
  • Experience working on or alongside a team developing mathematical software, such as optimization solvers, estimation engines, simulation frameworks, or applied probability models.


We request transcripts as part of the early application process to understand your academic background and how your coursework supports the skills deemed critical for the role. Transcripts help us assess your technical and analytical abilities, complementing our interview process in which we also evaluate practical experience and cultural fit. If you choose not to share your transcripts, you will need to provide detailed information regarding your academic performance in relevant courses, including projects and coursework specifics, to ensure we evaluate your academic accomplishments properly. If you do provide academic transcripts, feel free to redact non-technical information (e.g., student ID, dates, non-technical coursework, etc.). Unofficial transcripts obtained online acceptable for this assessment.

US Salary Range
$144,000—$192,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

 

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. 

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/. 

 

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

title: Strategic Real Estate, Portfolio Planning & Strategy Lead
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Position Summary
Anduril's real estate portfolio covers 10M sq ft of R&D labs, manufacturing hubs, and offices worldwide. As Portfolio Planning & Strategy Lead, you will own the planning process that decides how much space Anduril needs, of what type, where, and when.

You'll report to the Director of Strategic Real Estate. You'll turn headcount plans, program schedules, and portfolio data into forecasts of demand and supply. You'll measure how well we use what we already have, and make the case for what to do next to division leaders and the C-suite.

This is a hands-on senior role. It suits someone who builds their own models and can work from incomplete, inconsistent data. You should already use LLMs and modern data platforms (Palantir Foundry or similar) in your work. The ideal candidate combines real estate and financial judgment with a builder's instinct and a creative, tech-forward approach to problems that have no playbook.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the Real Estate Planning Cycle. Run the quarterly portfolio forecast end to end:
    • Gather headcount and program plans from Finance, Corporate Operations, and the business divisions;
    • Reconcile competing plans into one view of demand by division, workforce type, and region;
    • Publish the 5–10 year outlook that portfolio decisions rest on;
    • Track plan vs. actual across forecast versions, and explain why the numbers moved.
  • Portfolio Demand & Supply Forecasting. Forecast seat, office, R&D, and production space demand against current and committed supply. Quantify the gaps by market and year. Model scenarios (growth cases, program wins and losses, M&A, relocations, divestitures) and their OpEx and CapEx impact.
  • Efficiency & Utilization Measurement. Define and track the metrics that show whether the portfolio is working: SF per head, seat ratios, utilization, cost per seat, and production space relative to output. Benchmark them against peers. Turn the findings into recommendations to consolidate, densify, restructure leases, or expand.
  • Workforce Strategy. Work with Talent, People, and division leaders to understand how Anduril grows: hiring velocity, workforce mix (engineering, production, G&A), in-office patterns, and talent markets. Translate that into location strategy, market selection, and site timing.
  • Executive Communications. Build and present the decision materials that get C-suite and division-leader decisions made: quarterly business reviews, expansion option analyses, and leadership briefings. Lead with the answer, show the math, and stand behind the numbers.
  • Build the Planning System, Not Just the Plan. Maintain and extend our planning data pipeline and models (Palantir Foundry, Python/SQL, version-controlled datasets with automated validation), so forecasts are repeatable, auditable, and refreshable in hours. Use LLM-based agents to automate data extraction, reconciliation, analysis, and presentation production, and set the standard for how the team uses them.


Qualifications and Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Real Estate, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Data / Information Science, Urban Planning, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in strategic real estate planning, corporate portfolio strategy, FP&A, capacity or workforce planning, real estate investing (equity or credit), development, or corporate development, including experience leading or mentoring analysts/associates.
  • Strong financial and analytical modeling. You build your own models in Excel and Python or SQL, and can defend every number in them.
  • Hands-on use of LLMs and modern data platforms (Palantir Foundry or similar, such as Databricks, Snowflake, or dbt) in your current work.
  • Excellent communication, with a demonstrated capacity to influence cross-functional teams and senior executives.
  • Ability to travel up to 10% for site visits, stakeholder meetings, and industry events.
  • U.S. citizenship required; eligibility for security clearance preferred.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience forecasting space for manufacturing, R&D, or other capital-intensive operations, not only office.
  • A track record of building forecasts from incomplete or conflicting plan data, and explaining to leadership why they changed.
  • Experience planning around M&A integration, relocations, or consolidations.
  • Background in defense, aerospace, or another fast-growing hardware company.

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

We are Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI + Data + CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer too, driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good, you've come to the right place.

About the Role

Production leadership required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

 

Salesforce is hiring a Portfolio Leader to directly manage and grow a team of technical AI specialists deploying Agentforce solutions inside complex customer environments. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can drive engineering excellence while operating at the executive level. This is not a traditional people manager, but a mission-critical multiplier on the agentic frontier. You will lead a blended delivery team made up of two specialist functions: Forward Deployed Engineers (Technical Builders - who design, build, and deploy AI Agents directly in customer environments) and Deployment Strategists (Strategic Builders - customer-facing advisors who shape AI strategy, define use cases, and drive adoption). Together, these teams work alongside customers to co-build and deliver agentic AI solutions on a single large enterprise account or across multiple engagements simultaneously. You'll set the engineering standards, unblock complex customer deployments, and scale the talent that's shipping production AI today. 

The Builder Leadership Experience

Delivery Team Coordination: You own the capacity planning, talent acquisition, and staffing that ensures your cross-functional squads have the horsepower to deploy Agentforce at enterprise scale. 

AI-Augmented Leadership: Your team ships solutions using a best-in-class suite of AI tools (Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes). You will foster an inclusive, high-energy, and psychologically safe engineering culture where builders iterate fast and continuously level up.

Direct Product Influence: You stand at the center of the product feedback loop. Partner directly with the Product and Engineering organizations on pilot programs and beta rollouts, turning raw field insights from high-stakes deployments into features on the Agentforce core roadmap.

What You'll Actually Be Building & Execution

Leadership & Team Excellence

Scale Elite Talent: Recruit, mentor, and develop the next wave of Technical and Strategic Builders. Drive technical excellence, structure career growth, and foster an environment where shipping high-quality, production-ready systems is the norm.

Maintain Operational Velocity: Monitor key delivery metrics, coach your teams on optimization, and run hard on complex customer escalations. You ensure your teams move from sketch to deployable in weeks, not months.

Technical Strategy & Authority

Ultimate Technical Authority: Serve as the final technical escalation point for your portfolio. Maintain deep architectural judgment across the Salesforce platform, advanced LLM techniques, data pipelines, and agentic orchestration.

Guide Enterprise Implementations: Unblock complex data readiness, tool integration, and multi-agent orchestration challenges. Step in directly to help your teams assess customer technical readiness, remove deployment barriers, and codify standardized, repeatable delivery methodologies.

Customer & Business Impact

Drive Agentic Adoption: Build and anchor strong executive-level relationships within your customer portfolio, ensuring flawless Agentforce activation, rollout, and sustained production value.

Accelerate Portfolio Performance: Operationally run your account portfolio with engineering rigor - monitoring health, delivery velocity, and core consumption metrics to accelerate progress toward customer business outcomes.

Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner lock-step with Services, Account Success, and Product teams to help enterprises activate and consume Agentforce quickly, moving customers from pilot to production at hyper-speed.

You're Our Builder Lead If…

You Have Proven Leadership: 4+ years of direct people management or high-impact technical leadership steering cross-functional engineering or technical teams. You have a track record of hiring, mentoring, and scaling technical talent.

You Bring Advanced Technical Depth: Deep architectural understanding of AI, LLMs, and the Salesforce ecosystem. You have hands-on experience with enterprise software implementation, data modeling, API integration, and AI deployments.

You Own the Agentforce & Data Cloud Blueprint: You possess direct, hands-on experience architecting or deploying Salesforce Data Cloud and the Agentforce platform. You don't just understand the tech stack - you know how to orchestrate it to unblock enterprise scale and drive immediate production value.

You Lead with an Enterprise Customer Focus: Strong background navigating high-touch customer strategies at a Global level, paired with exceptional executive-level communication and influence skills. You can hold your own in a room with customer CTOs and enterprise architects.

You Have a Ship-It Mindset: Exceptional problem-solving instincts, extreme resourcefulness, and a "get-things-done" demeanor. You thrive at the technical helm where code is being actively shipped, not just talking about it.

Nice-to-Haves

Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems, prompt engineering pipelines, or deterministic AI guardrails.

Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery) and enterprise data pipelines.

Relevant Salesforce certifications (Advanced Admin, Service Cloud, Data Cloud, Sales Cloud, or Agentforce Specialist).

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. description:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

The Role and Impact

Intel's Global IT organization is seeking an experienced Senior Strategic IT Portfolio Manager to lead portfolio planning, prioritization, governance, and execution across a diverse portfolio of technology initiatives.

 

This role serves as a trusted advisor to business and technology leaders, driving investment decisions, optimizing resource allocation, and ensuring technology programs deliver measurable business value. The successful candidate will establish portfolio governance processes, provide executive-level insights into portfolio performance, and influence strategic decisions that support Intel's technology transformation objectives.

 

This position requires exceptional analytical capabilities, business acumen, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to operate effectively in a highly matrixed environment.

 

About the Team

The Global IT organization enables Intel's business through innovative technology solutions, operational excellence, and strategic transformation initiatives.

 

As part of the Enterprise and Technology Transformation Business Operations group, you will partner with technology, finance, and business stakeholders to drive portfolio optimization, strategic planning, governance excellence, and business outcomes across enterprise-wide IT investments.

 

What You’ll Do

Key responsibilities will include but not limited to:

 

Scenario Planning and Modeling: Build predictive resource, financial, and timeline models to simulate the impact of strategy changes, budget shifts, or project delays.

Strategic Prioritization: Manage the intake, evaluation, and prioritization of IT initiatives to ensure alignment with corporate goals.

Resource Capacity Planning: Analyze resource utilization and demand across the portfolio to optimize allocation and flag constraints.

Risk and Dependency Management: Track and mitigate cross-project dependencies, critical path items, and portfolio-level risks.

Performance Tracking: Monitor and report on the overall health, milestones, budget performance, and value delivery of all active IT projects.

 

Behavioral traits that we are looking for:

Strategic thinker with strong business acumen.

Executive presence and ability to influence senior stakeholders.

Data-driven decision maker.

Strong collaborator who excels in matrixed environments.

Skilled at navigating ambiguity and driving results.

Continuous improvement mindset and passion for operational excellence.

 

Intel invests in our people and offers a complete and competitive package of benefits employees and their families through every stage of life. 

See  Intel Benefits for more details. 

Qualifications:

You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. 

 

Note:

This position is not eligible for Intel immigration sponsorship.

 

Minimum Qualifications and Experience:

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Business Administration, Project Management, Computer Science, or a related discipline.

7+ years of experience in the following:   

Experience with portfolio management, financial management, strategic planning, or business operations.

Portfolio management software and tools, with a proven ability to analyze data and present actionable insights.

Experience with budgeting, resource allocation, and risk management principles.

Preferred Qualifications and Experience:

Master's degree in a relevant field with at least 5 + years of experience OR PhD with 3+ years of experience.

Experience working in technology-driven environments or supporting IT initiatives.

Proven track record of successfully implementing prioritization frameworks and optimization techniques.

Certification in portfolio management, such as PfMP or an equivalent program.

Experience with Intel tools and systems.

 

Why This Role is Attractive

Opportunity to influence strategic technology investment decisions across Intel.

Direct exposure to executive leadership and enterprise-wide transformation initiatives.

Significant impact on prioritization, funding, governance, and successful delivery of technology programs.

Collaborative environment focused on innovation, transformation, continuous improvement, and business value creation.

title: Remote Senior Agentic AI / CI/CD Software Engineer
description:
For a leading Swiss organisation, we are looking for an experienced Senior / Principal Agentic AI & CI/CD Software Engineer to support a strategic Agentic Engineering initiative.

The project focuses on establishing secure, scalable and repeatable engineering practices for AI agent capabilities, modernising software delivery processes, and improving engineering productivity through automation and measurable development metrics.

The ideal candidate combines strong hands-on CI/CD engineering expertise with a solid understanding of software supply chain security, GitHub/Bitbucket ecosystems and emerging Agentic AI development practices.

The assignment is structured into two phases:

  • Phase 1 (November–December 2026): Initial implementation, validation and delivery of key engineering capabilities.
  • Phase 2 (January–March 2027): Continuous improvement, integration enhancements and optimisation based on pilot feedback

Agentic AI Skills & Lifecycle Management

  • Establish secure and repeatable processes for validating, reviewing, approving and publishing AI agent skills.
  • Implement governance and quality controls for agent skills and related engineering workflows.
  • Demonstrate a complete skill lifecycle, including version management and rollback capabilities.
  • Ensure compliance with internal security guidelines and engineering standards.

CI/CD Engineering & DevSecOps

  • Design, implement and optimise secure CI/CD pipelines and reusable workflows.
  • Develop automated quality gates, validation mechanisms and secure deployment processes.
  • Work with containers, runners, scripting and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Implement security controls for dependencies, packages, secrets and access permissions.
  • Improve developer experience and engineering productivity through automation.

GitHub, Bitbucket & Engineering Metrics

  • Extract, process and analyse repository data using GitHub and Bitbucket APIs.
